item.title: Create a Worker Group and deploy it
item.description:
Guides › Examples › Worker Groups

Create a Worker Group and deploy it#

Cribl.Cloud example_cloud_create_worker_group.py

This example is for Cribl.Cloud deployments only.

Prerequisites#

  • pip install cribl-python-sdk
  • CRIBL_CLIENT_ID and CRIBL_CLIENT_SECRET env vars
  • CRIBL_CLOUD_URL env var

Environment variables#

Variable Default
CRIBL_CLIENT_ID your-client-id
CRIBL_CLIENT_SECRET your-client-secret
CRIBL_CLOUD_URL https://main-your-org.cribl.cloud
CRIBL_WORKER_GROUP_ID my-worker-group

Code#
